# oh-my-harness

> Independently maintained extensions for DeepSeek Harness and Antigravity, plus standalone Python tools for browser, desktop, SSH and image work. The kernels run trusted code with the permissions of their host.

The Chinese README is the primary, default documentation; the paired English documents cover the same behavior. Exact settings and platform constraints live in component READMEs. Complete values can remain in a session kernel while only evidence is displayed. Do not assume a short display proves a complete source or that an accepted request completed an external action.

## Start

- [Overview](README.en.md): Purpose, main capabilities, recorded example, and trust boundary.
- [Documentation](docs/README.en.md): Scenario-based reading paths.
- Follow the install path for your host or try an independent CLI. [Getting started](docs/getting-started.en.md)
- [Component catalog](docs/components.en.md): All public components grouped by problem.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.en.md): Host, upstream kernel, extension responsibilities, and source map.
- [Dotfiles integration](docs/dotfiles.en.md): Public code, private configuration, and optional integrations.
- [Maintenance](docs/maintenance.en.md): Checks, contribution priorities, and release review.
- [中文说明](README.md): Primary Chinese introduction.
- [Security](SECURITY.en.md): Trust boundaries and GitHub private vulnerability reporting.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.en.md): Scope, component environments, evidence, and review.
- [Agent guidance](AGENTS.md): Instructions for authorized changes in this repository.

## Capability guides

- [Python kernel](docs/dsh-python-repl.en.md): Persistent cells, complete values, snapshots, and limits.
- Install the desktop workbench and reuse variables across cells in an Antigravity conversation. [Antigravity workbench](agy-python-repl/README.md#install)
- [Control and supervision](docs/dsh-use.en.md): Existing-instance access, receipts, settled state, and controller/worker workflow.
- [Monitor](docs/dsh-monitor.en.md): Producer events, delivery modes, lifecycle, and gaps.
- [Output guard](docs/dsh-output-guard.en.md): Model-stream detection and bounded retry.
- [Compaction](docs/dsh-compaction-bound.en.md): Retention, exact-user-text indexing, and history-reader guidance.
- [Message tidy](docs/dsh-message-tidy.en.md): Instruction diffs and provenance-aware notices.
- [Image cap](docs/dsh-image-cap.en.md): Request image limits and resizing constraints.
- [History cap](docs/dsh-history-cap.en.md): UI history pagination, not model token limits.
- [Browser control](docs/browser-use.en.md) covers shared page and debugging APIs for Cra and Chrome, with an explicit tab ID.
- [Computer control](docs/computer-use.en.md): Native macOS targets, input, and result inspection.
- [Remote host](docs/remote-host.en.md): Real SSH destinations and content verification.

- [Runtime maintenance](dsh-runtime/README.en.md): Login environment, symlink-preserving saves, and profile YAML normalization.
- [Startup diagnostics](dsh-doctor/README.en.md): CLI, tool, and remote checks with actual App startup auditing.

- [Screenshot and media review](skills/shot-sheet/README.en.md): Contact sheets, extracted frames, before/after comparisons, and annotations from fictional media.

## Design and evidence

- [Python on DSH](docs/design/python-data-locality.en.md) explains how programmatic tool calling, Prime Agent’s execution core, and the DSH bridge fit together.
- [Choosing a browser tool](docs/design/browser-control.en.md) explains how Cra and Chrome target a tab and links the archived two-tab experiment.
- [Choosing a Mac desktop tool](docs/design/desktop-control.en.md) compares screen-driven interaction with addressing a native window.
- [Three generations of compaction](docs/design/three-generations-of-compaction.en.md): Historical choices and the current bounded host extension.
- [Controller and worker](docs/design/controller-worker.en.md): Receipts, observation, and independent acceptance.
- [Task isolation](docs/design/task-isolation.en.md): Shared accounts/desktops and target ownership.
- [Output boundaries](docs/design/output-guard.en.md): Display budgets, stream guards, and producer history.
- [Reproducible measurements](benchmarks/README.en.md): Fictional workloads, explicit estimates, and offline commands.
- [Measured output](benchmarks/results.json): Actual deterministic results with production source hashes.
- [Recording checklist](docs/assets/README.en.md): Real-media recording and verification requirements; a placeholder is not a completed demonstration.
